content: shadcn/ui (CLI current 4.13.0) fully supports Tailwind CSS v4 (current 4.3.2) and React 19; tailwindcss-animate is deprecated in favor of tw-animate-css; colors moved from HSL to OKLCH. This copy-in-your-repo component approach (not an npm UI dependency) is the standard modern choice for a custom-designed portfolio needing full control over styling.
